    model = "qwen-7b"  # default

        model = "qwen-7b"
    elif 'gpt4o' in eid_lower:
        model = "gpt-4o"

        model = "gpt-4.1"
    else:
        # Check spec for model info
        spec = exp.get('spec', {})

        if 'CodeLlama' in model_name or 'codellama' in model_name.lower():
            model = "codellama-13b"
        elif 'deepseek' in model_name.lower():
            model = "deepseek-6.7b"
        elif '1.5B' in model_name or '1.5b' in model_name.lower():
            model = "qwen-1.5b"
        elif 'Qwen' in model_name or 'qwen' in model_name.lower():
            model = "qwen-7b"
    
    # Seed detection
    seed_match = re.search(r'seed(\d+)', eid)
    seed = int(seed_match.group(1)) if seed_match else None
    if seed is None:

    condition = "unknown"

    print(f"{r['exp_id']:<55} {r['condition']:<25} {r['model']:<16} {seed:<6} {r['status']:<10} {r['conclusion']:<10} {acc:<10} {ci_l:<10} {ci_u:<10} {n:<6} {pr:<8} {fr:<8} {mb:<8} {li:<8}")
